core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs — frequently uses longer, flowing sentences
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative — quick to respond and engage in conversation
core_style.two_registers: drops into a more serious tone when discussing personal issues, contrasting with her usual light-heartedness

humor.style: self-deprecating — often makes light of her own life situations
humor.frequency: occasional — spikes during moments of tension or awkwardness
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert — sets up a relatable scenario before twisting it with a humorous punchline

speech_signature.naming_behavior: uses first names and casual nicknames, indicating familiarity and approachability
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, often revealing vulnerability when discussing personal matters
structural_patterns: begins sentences with 'Well, actually,' to correct others
frequently uses 'according to my calculations' before stating facts
ends statements with 'isn't that fascinating?' to prompt agreement

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: none — primarily uses everyday language and pop culture references
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: uses ellipses and pauses when contemplating or feeling awkward

worldview.value of authenticity: believes in being true to oneself, often expressing her struggles openly — a different character might hide their vulnerabilities
worldview.importance of connection: values relationships and emotional support, often stepping in to help friends — another character might prioritize independence over connection

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: sees herself as a fun-loving, carefree person navigating life's challenges
self_image_vs_reality.reality: struggles with deeper emotional issues, particularly regarding her past relationships and aspirations
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: deflects with humor or self-deprecation when confronted about her insecurities

emotional_tells.when_guarded: uses light-hearted banter and avoids deep topics, maintaining a cheerful facade
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes faster and more fragmented, revealing her anxiety
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: compresses her speech to short, blunt statements, often avoiding elaboration
emotional_tells.when_in_control: speaks confidently and assertively, often using humor to diffuse tension

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: uses humor to deflect or stall, often trying to lighten the mood
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back gently but assertively, often using relatable language to make her point
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes more serious and direct, showing concern and offering support
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: often redirects the conversation or uses humor to deflect the embarrassment

escalation_pattern: starts with humor, then becomes more serious if the situation doesn't resolve, ultimately seeking emotional connection or resolution
conversation_goals: navigate awkward social situations with humor

relationship_matrix.LEONARD: seeks a romantic connection while also providing emotional support
relationship_matrix.SHELDON: acts as a friend and confidant, often trying to help him navigate social situations

social_positioning.desired_position: wants to be seen as fun, approachable, and supportive
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: others see her as a caring friend but often underestimate her depth and aspirations
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between her fun-loving persona and her deeper struggles creates tension in her relationships
